resources.string: Share technical data about setup, connections and performance. Participation is optional and can be turned off in Settings.
No CarPlay images, audio, messages, locations or Wi-Fi details. Reports use a random installation ID and are kept for 30 days.
Reporting will stop. Shared reports and the installation ID will be deleted. Your CarPlay settings stay saved.

Thanks. Your technical feedback is saved.

With your permission, TesAir sends setup steps, permission results, app and device versions, video settings, connection outcomes and performance counters to telemetry.tesair.co.

Reports contain no screen content, audio, routes, contacts, messages, Wi-Fi names or passwords. A random ID links reports from this installation across updates. Uninstalling or clearing app data resets it.

Detailed events are deleted after 30 days. Statistics without installation IDs are retained for 90 days. Turn reporting off or delete your shared reports here at any time.
